semantics.transition: At each rising edge, if sampled a is 1 set q to 4; otherwise increment q, wrapping 6 to 0.
semantics.reset: No dedicated reset; a is a synchronous load-to-4 control.
semantics.initialization: No initialization; q is unknown until an edge with a=1.
semantics.between_edges: q holds, including falling edges and changes of a.
semantics.waveform_sampling: At 45ns a changes coincident with the rising edge; the displayed q=4 is interpreted as sampling the previous a=1. Subsequent edges sample a=0.

numeric.increment: q + 3-bit unsigned 1 when q is not 6
numeric.state_7: Unspecified by original waveform; ordinary 3-bit increment produces 0.
numeric.unknown_state: No guaranteed counting behavior until synchronous load.

verification.oracle: Independent integer model: load 4 on sampled a=1, else (expected+1)%7.
verification.directed: Replay edge outputs 4,4,4,4,4,4,5,6,0,1 with input changes driven away from sampling races; verify initial unknown.
verification.coverage: Multiple full modulo-7 cycles, synchronous reload from every legal state, repeated loads, input toggles between edges, falling-edge hold.
verification.execution: Icarus -g2012 with explicit dev_tb top and finite compile and simulation timeouts; internal testbench watchdog.

specification_ambiguities.issue: Input a transition coincides with rising edge at 45ns.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Treat displayed input as post-edge and sampled input as previous value; no extra pipeline is inferred.

specification_ambiguities.issue: Short waveform does not uniquely define all possible sequential circuits or state 7.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Use simplest synchronous loadable modulo-7 counter consistent with shown sequence; no reset or initial value added.
